case_number: 2025 INSC 65; CONTEMPT PETITION (C) NO. 741 OF 2020; CONTEMPT PETITION (C) NO. 1030 OF 2018; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 2703 OF 2017
summary: Non-compliance of absorption order; arrears and pension disputed; fact-finding enquiry directed; pension stoppage not justified by prior orders; Registrar/Vice Chancellor to adjudicate claims on actual working, salary arrears, and pension; recovery mechanism for excess payment; remedy available before High Court if dissatisfied.
legal_provisions_cited: State of Bihar & others vs Bihar Rajya M.S.E.S.K.K.M & others (2005) 9 SCC 129
final_judgment: Contempt petition disposed of with directions for adjudication of salary arrears and pension by Registrar/Vice Chancellor within specified timeframes; recovery permitted for excess payments; remedy before High Court preserved.
